mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the 3-month Treasury yield indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises discount rates, lowering the present value of future equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the 3-month Treasury yield followed by a sustained decline in the 10-year yield signals a shift from tightening to accommodative policy, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above UNRATE and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, raising consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
